cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: How Many?.

words.en: Lily has a few red apples.
more: I need a few pencils for school.
我需要几支铅笔去上学。
There are a few birds in the tree.
树上有几只鸟。

words.en: Tom reads all the books.
more: We clean all the windows.
我们擦所有的窗户。
All my friends like pizza.
我所有的朋友都喜欢披萨。

words.en: Mia has all kinds of toys.
words.sz: Mia 有各种各样的玩具。
more: The shop sells all kinds of fruit.
这家商店卖各种各样的水果。
Grandma grows all kinds of flowers.
奶奶种各种各样的花。

words.en: Kate buys all sorts of wool.
words.sz: Kate 买各种各样的毛线。
more: We hear all sorts of sounds in the park.
我们在公园里听到各种各样的声音。
Dad reads all sorts of newspapers.
爸爸读各种各样的报纸。

words.en: Is there any milk left?
more: You can ask me any question.
你可以问我任何问题。
I don't have any money today.
我今天没有钱。

words.en: Lily likes both dresses.
more: Both cats are sleeping on the sofa.
两只猫都在沙发上睡觉。
Dad and Mum both work hard.
爸爸和妈妈都很努力工作。

words.en: Tom eats a bit of cake.
more: Wait a bit, please.
请稍等一下。
The dog is a bit hungry.
狗有点饿了。

words.en: Mum sleeps in a double bed.
more: This is a double room.
这是一间双人间。
He pays double for the ticket.
他付双倍的钱买票。

words.en: Each child gets a gift.
words.sz: 每个孩子都收到一份礼物。
more: Each flower is red.
每朵花都是红色的。
Each child has a chair.
每个孩子都有一把椅子。

words.en: We have enough food.
more: There is enough time to play.
有足够的时间玩。
The box is big enough for the dog.
这个盒子对狗来说够大了。

words.en: Max walks every morning.
more: Lily brushes her teeth every night.
Lily 每天晚上都刷牙。
We go to school every day.
我们每天都去上学。

words.zh: 很少；几乎没有（用于可数名词）
words.en: There are few leaves on the tree.
more: Few students are late today.
今天很少学生迟到。
Few people swim in winter.
冬天很少有人游泳。

words.en: The ice cream is half-price.
more: We buy half-price tickets online.
我们在网上买半价票。
These apples are half-price today.
这些苹果今天半价。

words.en: Of all the bags, the red one costs the least.
words.sz: 所有包里，红色的那个最便宜。
more: This is the least expensive shop.
这是最便宜的商店。
She has the least homework.
她的作业最少。

words.en: I drink less juice.
more: There is less water in the pool.
游泳池里的水变少了。
We have less time now.
我们现在时间更少了。

words.en: Tom is a little boy.
more: I have a little dog named Max.
我有一只叫 Max 的小狗。
She has little time for games.
她几乎没有时间玩游戏。

words.en: Tom has lots of toys.
more: We have lots of fun at the park.
我们在公园玩得很开心。
Lily has lots of friends at school.
Lily 在学校有很多朋友。

words.en: How many eggs do we need?
more: There are many trees in the park.
公园里有很多树。
Not many people are here today.
今天这里人不多。

words.en: The house costs one million pounds.
words.sz: 这栋房子价值一百万英镑。
more: Tom wants to win a million pounds!
Tom 想赢一百万英镑！
There are millions of stars in the sky.
天上有几百万颗星星。

words.en: Mum, can I have more bread?
words.sz: 妈妈，我能再来点面包吗？
more: We need more time to finish.
我们需要更多时间来完成。
Play with Max for five minutes more.
再和 Max 玩五分钟。

words.en: Lily has the most stars in her class.
words.sz: Lily 在班上拥有最多的星星。
more: Most children like ice cream.
大多数孩子喜欢冰淇淋。
Which film do you like most?
你最喜欢哪部电影？

words.en: How much time do we have?
more: I don't have much money.
我没有多少钱。
Thank you very much for the gift.
非常感谢这份礼物。

words.en: What is your bus number?
more: Write the number in your book.
把数字写在书里。
Tom knows his phone number.
Tom 知道他的电话号码。

words.en: Tom has a new pair of shoes.
more: I need a pair of gloves.
我需要一副手套。
Grandma has a pair of glasses.
奶奶有一副眼镜。

words.en: Lily wants a piece of cake.
more: Cut the apple into small pieces.
把苹果切成小块。
Can I have a piece of paper?
我能拿一张纸吗？

words.en: The test was quite easy.
more: It is quite cold outside today.
今天外面相当冷。
Mia is quite tall for her age.
按年龄来说，Mia 相当高。

words.en: Tom ate several strawberries.
more: We saw several birds in the garden.
我们在花园里看到了几只鸟。
Grandma has several cats at home.
奶奶家里有几只猫。

words.en: Tom found a single sock.
more: There isn't a single cloud in the sky.
天上一朵云都没有。
Every single child came to the party.
每一个孩子都来参加派对了。

words.en: Dad bought some bananas.
more: Would you like some tea?
你想喝点茶吗？
There are some birds in the tree.
树上有几只鸟。

words.en: It was such a nice day.
more: Max is such a good dog.
Max 真是只乖狗狗。
She is such a kind girl.
她真是个善良的女孩。

words.en: The total cost is five pounds.
more: What's the total score?
总分是多少？
The total number of students is twenty.
学生总数是二十人。

words.en: Tom is very tired.
more: The water is very cold.
水很冷。
Lily is very happy today.
Lily 今天非常开心。

words.en: Tom eats the whole pizza.
more: The whole family is at the park.
全家人都在公园里。
Lily reads the whole book in one day.
Lily 一天读完了整本书。

words.en: The temperature is zero degrees.
more: Our team has zero points.
我们队得了零分。
My team scored zero goals.
我们队进了零个球。

words.en: Tom is almost at the finish line.
more: It's almost dinner time.
快到晚饭时间了。
Max is almost sleeping on the sofa.
Max 在沙发上快睡着了。

words.en: We are nearly home.
more: The test is nearly over.
考试快结束了。
It's nearly five o'clock.
快五点了。

words.en: Even Grandma likes this game.
words.sz: 连奶奶都喜欢这个游戏。
more: Even Max wants to join us.
连 Max 都想加入我们。
It's so cold, even the birds stay inside.
太冷了，甚至连鸟儿都待在室内。

words.en: Lily likes chocolate, especially dark chocolate.
words.sz: Lily 喜欢巧克力，尤其是黑巧克力。
more: We love holidays, especially summer holidays.
我们喜欢假期，尤其是暑假。
Max loves food, especially chicken.
Max 爱吃东西，尤其是鸡肉。

words.en: The bus comes at exactly eight.
more: That's exactly what I wanted.
那正是我想要的。
Tom is exactly six years old.
Tom 正好六岁。

words.en: Tom is really tall for his age.
words.sz: Tom 在他这个年纪真的很高。
more: I'm really hungry now.
我现在真的很饿。
This film is really funny.
这部电影真的很好笑。

words.en: Dad buys an extra bag of bread.
words.sz: 爸爸买了一袋额外的面包。
more: We need an extra chair for Sam.
我们需要一把额外的椅子给 Sam。
Mum has an extra apple for lunch.
妈妈有一个额外的苹果当午餐。

words.en: What size are your shoes?
more: This T-shirt is the right size.
这件 T 恤尺码合适。
Lily checks the size of her dress.
Lily 查看她裙子的尺码。

words.en: What is the length of this belt?
words.sz: 这条腰带的长度是多少？
more: The river's length is very long.
这条河的长度很长。
Check the length of the shelf.
检查一下架子的长度。

words.en: What type of apple do you like?
more: I like this type of music.
我喜欢这种类型的音乐。
There are many types of dogs.
有很多种狗。

words.en: This sort of toy is soft.
more: What sort of cake is this?
这是哪种蛋糕？
I don't like that sort of game.
我不喜欢那种游戏。

words.en: There is a variety of sweets here.
words.sz: 这里有各种各样的糖果。
more: The market has a variety of fruit.
市场里有各种各样的水果。
We see a variety of birds in the park.
我们在公园里看到各种各样的鸟。

words.en: Lily has various pens.
words.sz: Lily 有各种各样的钢笔。
more: We visited various places in London.
我们在伦敦参观了各个地方。
The shop sells various kinds of bread.
这家店卖各种各样的面包。

words.en: This is a part of the puzzle.
more: The head is part of the body.
头是身体的一部分。
Mum washes this part of the car.
妈妈洗车身的这一部分。
